{{Quote|One day, the Phlogs decided to build a palace for their king.|Logray|<ref name="HEST" />}}
Many generations before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], '''a king''' ruled over the [[Phlog/Legends|Phlogs]] who lived in the land of [[Desert of Simoom|Simoom]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]]. At some point, [[Gender/Legends|his]] subjects decided to build a [[Phlog king's palace|palace]] for him, which prompted them to chop down all the [[Tree/Legends|trees]] of the land to build it. Because of that, Simoom became a [[Desert/Legends|desert]], and the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] tribes who lived there were forced to flee to other side of the Forest Moon.<ref name="HEST" />
